cohort: The study included 320 term pregnant women from Kenya, equally divided into those who underwent cultural abdominal massage and those who did not.
finding: Women who underwent cultural abdominal massage in pregnancy had an increased risk of primary postpartum hemorrhage, uterine rupture, stillbirth, and a 5-minute Apgar score below 7.
mod_finding: There was no association found between cultural abdominal massage and cesarean hysterectomy.
